args.name: Small-sample food preparation and measured air drying
args.function: Enable a physically grounded experiment exposing the interior of a small owned root sample and measuring actual moisture change against an equal untreated reference. Identify feasible preparation, support and measurement methods; do not grant preservation automatically.
args.conditions: At tick 14 I own 6.9 roots, health is 100, satiety 81.4 and energy 39.3. Root nutrition 14 and toxicity 0 are personally known. A press trial consumed 0.1 root and recorded flexibility 0 at load 0.25. Heating failed for lack of a nearby heat source. I have no confirmed suitable tool or clean support. Current weather is mild with no rain.
args.inputs: Small owned root sample and equal untreated reference. Any needed tool, clean support or measuring equipment must actually be identified and acquired. Preparation method and required materials remain unknown.
args.costs: Unknown. Require actual learning time, effort, elapsed drying time and material expenditure as appropriate. Preserve enough roots for meals; do not reserve my entire food supply.
args.effects: Permit preparation and observation of physically represented moisture change and sample condition under actual weather. Failure is possible. No automatic safety, preservation, nutritional improvement or reward; conclusions require real trials.

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
candidates.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.

candidates.function: Lay a small open fuel bed of your own fuel, light it by hand friction or from a hot bed, feed, inspect or smother it; it burns on its own until fuel or air runs out.
candidates.costs: Study 4 rounds. Beds are in reach within 0.65 m. tend, 1 round, 0.5 energy: with x,y lays a new 0.2 m bed (firm open ground, footprint clear, nobody on it), else feeds your own bed; takes quantity (default 1) from each own fuelItemIds item (inedible with fuel value) and tinderItemIds item (dry grass, bark, moss, reed); holds 1.6 kg. inspect: anyone, 1 round, 0.2 energy via probe observe. attempt-ignition on your unlit bed with 0.5 tinder and 0.5 fuel, inspected by you within 10 rounds, while you hold sand or clay totaling 2.01 kg named in extinguishingItemIds: friction, toolItemIds rubbing then base piece, whole rigid wood units at least 0.3 m long, rubbing 1.5-5 cm thick and not softer, base 3 cm+, durationRounds 1-5 (default 3) at 1 energy per worked round; hot-target, 1 round, 0.5 energy, from the bed at 300 C+ or a brand from your burning bed within 1 m. extinguish: anyone, 1 round, 0.5 energy plus 2.01 kg of your listed sand or clay (or quantity from each). Failed checks spend nothing.
candidates.effects: Water share is the represented one (branch 0.5, dry grass 0.4); only burning fuel dries. Friction: 1 energy = 21.6 kJ; contact reaches air+15(n-1)+contact*dryness*500/(1+0.5wind) C, dryness 1-water/0.35, contact rising as the groove wears; 350 C with 2 g dust forms an ember, which lights tinder of water <=0.35 at rain <=0.15 and wind <=0.65; wear 2 g a round. Fire: up to 1 fuel unit (2 MJ) a round times (1-water), 10% ash, embers 3 rounds, rain >0.6 douses, rain wets fuel +0.08*rain; burning fuel dries 0.08 a round; leaving or death never stops it. A fifth of the heat holds the bed, a tenth reaches people: within 2 m +0.6*burn*(1-d/2)*(1-0.5wind) degrees; on the bed -5*burn health; loose fuel and combustible stock within 0.45 m catch; probes in reach draw stored heat. Smothering closes air; the bed cools; inspect reads it. No cooking, safety or reward.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.
